sentences.text: Valkama Watercrafts Oy is a portfolio company registered on 2022-03-16 under the industry code 30120, building of pleasure and sporting boats.
First sales are recorded on 2022-04-01 and a first hire on 2022-06-01, with a start-up notification dated 2022-05-17.
Funding on record is a round dated 2023-04-04 and a Business Finland decision of EUR 50 000 for 2022, with share issues dated 2023-09-29 and 2024-07-18.
An employer-register record marked as ended is dated 2026-04-30, and the record does not say why.
For the fund the memo says watchlist because ocean impact and investment readiness read Low and no decision row matches.
